purpose: Separate logical placement geometry from the raster dimensions used to render and review an image-variation candidate.
principles: placement dimensions describe composition intent, not desired source or output factual resolution
master dimensions are an integer multiple of placement dimensions so relative geometry remains identical
a larger master raster may improve transform quality and downstream flexibility but does not create factual source detail
placement previews used for evaluation are derived from the master rather than independently re-planned
source authority, semantic orientation and fidelity remain independent gates

reviewScales.purpose: Inspect transform quality, edge behavior, halos and whether the asset remains useful outside one exact placement raster.
Judge visible catalog utility at the actual logical holder size.
Inspect characteristic holes, fittings, terminals and segmentation boundaries without treating interpolation as new factual detail.

nonGoals: claiming 4x masters have four times the factual source resolution
upscaling low-resolution sources as a substitute for better factual evidence
changing composition semantics between master and placement
